toolCalls: Bash: ls -la && ls -la work bin 2>/dev/null; cat rule.md
Bash: cat cli.md; echo ------; cat format.md; echo -----; cat prompt.md; ls -la bin tmp work

Bash: cat > work/check.json <<'EOF'
{
  "format": 1,
  "rule": "req~heading-folding.fold~1",
  "example": "folding a task",
  "files": {"tasks.md": "# Tasks\n## Fix the reaper\nIt leaks.\n# Notes\n"},
  "steps": [
    {"line": "* Given a notebook with the lines \"# Tasks\", \"## Fix the reaper\", \"It leaks.\" and \"# Notes\" is open",
     "do": [{"launch": {"build": "debug", "inspector": true}},
            {"drive": ["menu", "File > Open…"]},
            {"drive": ["choose", {"file": "tasks.md"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "opened"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".opened.json.sections.notebook | [.drawn[].text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\") | select(. != \"\")] == [\"# Tasks\", \"## Fix the reaper\", \"It leaks.\", \"# Notes\"]",
                 "why": "the window shows the notebook's four lines, in order"},
                {"that": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.length == (\"# Tasks\\n## Fix the reaper\\nIt leaks.\\n# Notes\\n\" | length)",
                 "why": "the open notebook holds the whole fixture"}]},
    {"line": "* And the selection is in \"## Fix the reaper\"",
     "do": [{"drive": ["click",
                       {"jq": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .rect | .x + .width / 2"},
                       {"jq": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .rect | .y + .height / 2"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "selected"}],
     "expect": [{"that": "(.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .offset) as $h | .selected.json.sections.notebook.selection | .location >= $h and .location + .length <= $h + (\"## Fix the reaper\" | length)",
                 "why": "the selection lies within the line \"## Fix the reaper\""}]},
    {"line": "* When the user chooses View > Fold Heading",
     "do": [{"drive": ["menu", "View > Fold Heading"]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "afterFold"}],
     "expect": []},
    {"line": "* Then \"It leaks.\" is hidden",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": "(.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"It leaks.\") | .offset) as $l | .afterFold.json.sections.notebook.drawn | all(.[]; ((.text | contains(\"It leaks.\")) | not) and (.offset > $l or .offset + (.text | length) <= $l))",
                 "why": "no paragraph the window shows holds \"It leaks.\""},
                {"that": ".afterFold.json.sections.notebook.length == .opened.json.sections.notebook.length",
                 "why": "the text is hidden, not removed"}]},
    {"line": "* And \"## Fix the reaper\" shows the folded marker",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": "(.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .offset) as $h | .afterFold.json.sections.notebook | any(.folded[]; .offset == $h and (.line | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\")",
                 "why": "the heading is marked as folded"},
                {"that": "(.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .offset) as $h | .afterFold.json.sections.notebook as $n | ($n.drawn[] | select(.offset == $h and (.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .rect) as $d | any($n.markers[]; .heading == $h and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.y < $d.y + $d.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > $d.y)",
                 "why": "the heading is on screen with a folded marker beside it"}]},
    {"line": "* And \"# Tasks\" and \"# Notes\" are visible",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": ".afterFold.json as $s | [\"# Tasks\", \"# Notes\"] | all(.[] as $t; any($s.sections.notebook.drawn[]; (.text | rtrimstr(\"\\n\")) == $t and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.y < $s.window.content.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > 0 and .rect.x < $s.window.content.width and .rect.x + .rect.width > 0))",
                 "why": "both top-level headings are drawn within the window"}]}
  ]
}
EOF
bin/palantir-accept lint work/check.json rule.md
Bash: /usr/bin/sed -i '' 's/all(\.\[\] as \$t; any(/all(.[]; . as $t | any(/' work/check.json && grep -n 'as \$t' work/check.json && bin/palantir-accept lint work/check.json rule.md

Bash: which jq && mkdir -p tmp/mock && cat > tmp/mock/rec.json <<'EOF'
{"opened":{"json":{"window":{"content":{"width":960,"height":600}},"sections":{"notebook":{"length":44,"folded":[],"markers":[],
 "drawn":[{"offset":0,"text":"# Tasks","rect":{"x":25,"y":0,"width":60,"height":20}},
          {"offset":8,"text":"## Fix the reaper","rect":{"x":25,"y":20,"width":120,"height":18}},
          {"offset":26,"text":"It leaks.","rect":{"x":25,"y":38,"width":60,"height":16}},
          {"offset":36,"text":"# Notes","rect":{"x":25,"y":54,"width":60,"height":20}}],
 "selection":{"location":0,"length":0}}}}},
 "selected":{"json":{"sections":{"notebook":{"selection":{"location":15,"length":0}}}}},
 "afterFold":{"json":{"window":{"content":{"width":960,"height":600}},"sections":{"notebook":{"length":44,
 "folded":[{"offset":8,"line":"## Fix the reaper"}],
 "markers":[{"heading":8,"label":"…","rect":{"x":150,"y":20,"width":16,"height":16}}],
 "drawn":[{"offset":0,"text":"# Tasks","rect":{"x":25,"y":0,"width":60,"height":20}},
          {"offset":8,"text":"## Fix the reaper","rect":{"x":25,"y":20,"width":120,"height":18}},
          {"offset":36,"text":"# Notes","rect":{"x":25,"y":38,"width":60,"height":20}}]}}}}}
EOF
jq -r '.steps[] | .expect[].that' work/check.json > tmp/mock/exprs.txt
while IFS= read -r e; do printf '%s\n' "$(jq "$e" tmp/mock/rec.json)"; done < tmp/mock/exprs.txt
echo --- broken: no fold
jq '.afterFold = (.opened | .json.window.content={"width":960,"height":600})' tmp/mock/rec.json > tmp/mock/bad.json
tail -n 4 tmp/mock/exprs.txt | while IFS= read -r e; do printf '%s\n' "$(jq "$e" tmp/mock/bad.json)"; done
Bash: ls tmp/mock 2>/dev/null; rm -rf tmp/mock; bin/palantir-accept lint work/check.json rule.md
